name: Manish Botta
headline:
Backend depth.
AI in production.
intro: I build the systems behind the product. From retrieval agents for Microsoft’s field sales teams to a B2B platform built from the ground up, I take software from the first question to production.
bio: I’m a software engineer based in San Francisco. My work lives where backend engineering, applied AI, and real customer problems meet.
I’ve built retrieval and agent systems inside Microsoft’s sales organization, worked with enterprise teams at Yellow.ai, and owned product and engineering for TradeLiv as its first and sole engineer.

I enjoy the parts that make a system useful beyond a demo: permission checks, thoughtful data models, reliable queues, and a clear path from a customer’s problem to something they can use. I’m comfortable moving between architecture, implementation, and the conversations that shape both.

bullets: Owned product and engineering as the first hire and sole engineer, taking a B2B SaaS platform from zero to production in four months with 40 REST endpoints, PostgreSQL, and designer, admin, and client access tiers.
Cut new e-commerce integration time from two days to under 15 minutes by replacing per-site scrapers with a Claude and Puppeteer pipeline that turns product URLs into structured data.
Ran the stack on one 1GB OCI VM, offloading builds to GitHub Actions and using health-gated cutover with automatic rollback for zero-downtime deployment; owned incidents through customer follow-up.
Raised semantic retrieval accuracy 36 percent by replacing fixed-size chunking with heading-scoped parent and child chunks across documents above 20 MB.
Built a multi-agent orchestration system for field sales across Salesforce, HubSpot, OneDrive, and internal databases on Azure, serving 75,000 daily users and 1.5 million requests over six months.
Cut contract and document lookup from about 15 minutes to under 30 seconds with an agent backend over Salesforce, HubSpot, OneDrive, and internal SQL.
Raised retrieval accuracy from 61% to 89% with chunk-level indexing, reranking, and a vector cache in front of the RAG layer.
Cut per-query inference cost 45% by fine-tuning a smaller model with QLoRA and PEFT and routing simple intents away from the larger model.
Moved authorization inside the agent loop with Graph API tenant isolation and RBAC per request, restricting retrieval to contracts the requesting persona could access.
Hardened tool calls with exponential backoff, capped retries, a dead-letter queue, and per-node fallbacks, tracing runs in LangSmith to investigate divergent plans.
Delivered conversational-AI systems for 24+ enterprise clients including IHCL, Dr. Reddy’s, Bajaj Finserv, and Spotify, scoping use cases with customer teams.
Unblocked launches through on-site CRM, ticketing, and data integrations at IHCL, Dr. Reddy’s, and Bajaj Finserv, driving InfoSec approvals on both sides.
Held 99.9% uptime on the messaging backbone as the product received 100M+ daily events across all customers, owning consumer services and retry paths on a six-engineer platform team.
Cut p95 API response time from 820ms to 490ms by rewriting MySQL and MongoDB query plans, adding composite indexes, and caching hot reads in Redis.
Onboarded 50+ enterprise CRM integrations without latency regression through a shared connector interface reused per client.
Fine-tuned BERT and open-source LLMs with LoRA for intent classification and named entity recognition, lifting chatbot accuracy 60% and CSAT 35%.

experience.role: Program Trainee Analyst, Full Stack Developer
bullets: Cut order-lookup response time from 1.2s to 700ms by decomposing a legacy Java monolith into Spring Boot microservices and REST APIs, holding automated test coverage above 80%.
Improved team velocity 30% during the migration.

principles.title: Start with the real workflow
principles.text: Talk to the people using the system. Understand their constraints before committing to an architecture.

principles.title: Make the failure paths work
principles.text: Retries, permissions, observability, and recovery belong in the design from the beginning.

principles.title: Own the last mile
principles.text: Deployment, integrations, documentation, and production support are part of building the product.

hiringIntro: I’m looking for software engineering, AI engineering, and forward-deployed roles across software and AI. I bring backend depth, production AI experience, and ownership from customer discovery through delivery.
